01

The invitation

Where science meets real life.

We'd love to welcome you as a VIP creator partner for Wellness + Connection, a Maktoub experience bringing together movement, recovery, breathwork and meaningful social connection.

As a doctor with a passion for fitness, you have a perspective that feels especially relevant: credible, curious, and grounded in how people actually live. We want your science-informed point of view, delivered in your voice, with your energy.

“Recovery isn't only about performance. It's also about how we feel, think and connect.”

03

Creative direction

The science of feeling better.

Three thoughtful, engaging videos that balance useful information with a cool, candid look at the experience. No scripted sales pitch; no exaggerated medical claims.

Video 01 · Before

Recovery, decoded.

Introduce the experience through cold exposure, physical recovery, stress and mental clarity. What does the evidence actually support about ice baths, and what are the limits?

Video 02 · On site

Experience the science.

Film the activations, breathwork, movement, atmosphere and your genuine reactions. Discuss how breathing practices may support stress regulation and focus.

Video 03 · After

Beyond the gym.

A personal, reflective takeaway on recovery, wellbeing and social connection, with practical insights your audience can apply.

Shared goal

Make the invitation count.

Our campaign aims to turn genuine curiosity into attendance, not just views. Your referral link will allow Maktoub to attribute bookings to your content, without asking your followers to type a promo code.

07

Working together

A relationship, not a transaction.

We're interested in creating content that builds your profile as a doctor and fitness voice while bringing a fresh, credible perspective to Maktoub. We want this to feel valuable to your audience, and worth being associated with.

A few good principles

Authentic voice. You retain your editorial personality and professional judgment.

Responsible science. Avoid promises that ice baths or breathwork treat mental-health conditions.

Transparent partnership. Complimentary benefits and promotional content should be disclosed clearly.

Mutual content rights. Reposting, portfolio use and any paid advertisement usage require agreed permissions.
